title: patch
description: Apply one or more edit operations atomically inside an isolated transaction. Each operation references an observed source hash; stale anchors are rejected. The transaction commits atomically or rolls back to baseline. Supports ReplaceSymbol, Range, ExactText, Insert, Delete, CreateFile, MoveFile, DeleteFile, and UnifiedDiff operations.

path.description: worktree:// URI of the target file.

observed_hash.description: The sha256 of the file as last read by the model. Stale hashes are rejected.

validation_profile.description: Validation to run before commit. 'language_fast' parses touched regions; 'language_strict' also runs diagnostics.

isolated_transaction.description: If true, intermediate files may not parse; the transaction cannot commit until all invariants pass. Use for multi-file refactors.
